taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Both words name light, witty back-and-forth conversation, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Black tie? React with surprise

clue.text: Narrow fiddle lacking mass

explanation.definitionFit: To continue doing something is to keep at it, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Loyalty, say, retained by association

clue.text: Foul, last of several by one in team

clue.text: Card game and sport S C duke played

clue.text: Closest attention received by home

explanation.surface: Close attention given to someone at home.

clue.text: Conductor using chosen C S baton with energy

clue.text: Part of carousel essentially serving no purpose

explanation.surface: A fairground roundabout judged essentially pointless.

clue.text: View about national assembly

clue.text: Act quietly, referring to nurse

clue.text: Talk from salesman on new design

clue.text: Hot and bothered on ship at sea, wanting hospital

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

clue.text: Ruin caused by fuel with higher price
